The Capital Markets Authority (CMA) Corporate
Governance Assessment Report for Stanbic Holdings
Plc for the year ended 31 December 2024 found that
Stanbic Holdings Plc had continued to demonstrate
commitment to good corporate governance and was
thus awarded a leadership rating for the sixth‑year
running.
Stanbic Holdings Plc was commended by CMA for
its continuous efforts to strengthen its governance
structures and practices. CMA made some
recommendations on areas of improvement which the
company is addressing.
Governance Audit

In line with the Code of Corporate Governance Practices
for Issuers of Securities to the Public (the CG Code), the
Company engaged NewDay Secretarial & Consulting
Limited, an independent governance auditor to undertake
an independent governance audit for the year ended
December 31, 2025.
